name: Runway Growth Finance Corp. (externally-managed venture-debt BDC; absorbed SWK Holdings 2026-04-06)
recommendation: STARTER-HALF 0.35% (~$3.5k, ~560sh) ONLY at <=$6.25 — a price gate BELOW the demonstrated Carlson supply zone ($6.59-6.64), never into it; NO AVERAGING UP; GTC cancel-by 2026-10-23 (resting-order-into-print rule; Q3 print ~11/05 UNCONFIRMED). At the current tape (~$6.60-7.05): NO ORDER.
verdict: STARTER-HALF at a hard price gate — NOT the 19.9% 'covered' yield story. The marketed 1.30x dividend coverage is DEAD on both benches' arithmetic: Q2's incentive fee was $(199)k vs +$3,523k a year ago BECAUSE $45.3M of realized losses impaired the adviser's total-return hurdle — the coverage metric and the credit-damage claim are the same variable with opposite signs. Blue derived the fee from the N-2 formula (20% x $17,992k = $3,598k, validated against Q2'25 actuals) and got normalized NII $0.341/sh vs the $0.33 dividend = 1.03x. That kills DAMAGE-ABSENT and the yield-safety story, but it is a VALUATION response -> PRICE GATE, not a classification kill: $1.36/yr normalized NII on a $6.25 entry is a 21.8% earnings yield. Red's ONLY novel credit-quality kill (risk-rating decomposition implying legacy deterioration to 3.01-3.26) was STRUCK as arithmetically impossible — at the disclosed weight (SWK loans $216.2M of ~$1.1B, w=0.197) the implied legacy rating is 2.42-2.67 across any plausible SWK input; reaching red's numbers requires SWK at ~70% of the book. Audit recomputed and confirms blue. What binds: leverage 1.36x vs management's own range top, 174.0% asset coverage with breach at a 13.7% portfolio markdown and NAV beta 2.36x (SIZE CAP); Carlson holds 3.885M sh (~9.2%, ~6 days ADV) with demonstrated supply at $6.59-6.64 plus ~6.4M SWK-consideration shares issued at $11.93 NAV now -45% with no located lockup (ENTRY GATE); and the $900M of legacy level-3 marks are unverifiable with any desk connector — but they re-mark every 90 days, so unverifiable-today is a timing constraint, not an unfalsifiable kill.

court.kill_class_tally: 2 NOVEL sustained (incentive-fee-funded coverage -> price gate; legacy-income -16% YoY reduced to rate-compression headwind) / 2 CONSENSUS sustained as size+entry instruments (breach-zone leverage; Carlson flow) / 1 NOVEL STRUCK (rating-decomposition — arithmetically impossible)
court.blue_corrections_audited: Decomposition: 0.803L+0.197S=2.34 gives L=2.67(S=1.0)/2.55(S=1.5)/2.42(S=2.0) — CONFIRMED by recomputation; red's 3.01-3.26 unreproducible. Fee formula: 20% x 17,992 = 3,598, prior-year validation 20% x 17,471 = 3,494 vs 3,523 actual — CONFIRMED. Normalized NII 18,191-3,797 = 14,394k = $0.341/sh on 42.215M sh — CONFIRMED. Asset coverage (502,578+678,945)/678,945 = 174.0%, breach markdown $163.1M = 13.7% of $1,192.4M — CONFIRMED.
court.clean_court_note: Hard FLAT was considered and declined: red's kills reduce to valuation (price gate) and size/timing instruments under the response taxonomy; marks-unverifiability is not a data-integrity kill (nothing alleges dishonest marks, only undissected ones) and the Carlson overhang is undated supply, not a dated cliff. Blue's gated starter honors the value-ladder flow gate by sitting below the supply, not in it.

proposed_order.rationale: Half a normal starter at the bottom of blue's 0.35-0.50% band (red at 8/10; two consensus constraints live). $6.25 is below Carlson's demonstrated $6.59-6.64 supply — we buy capitulation, never distribution. Cancel-by keeps the resting bid from being short-vol into the Q3 print. If unfilled by 10/23, the Q3 print re-derives everything.

upgrade_gates_full_starter_on_any: Q3 10-Q disclosing the legacy-vs-SWK risk-rating split with legacy <=2.67
NII >=$0.35/sh WITH a positive incentive fee accrued (coverage that survives the fee resuming)
kill_triggers: Dividend cut before the incentive fee normalizes
Adviser buyback 'intent' still <=1,000 insider shares by the Q3 print while leverage stays >1.30x (the commitment revealed as pure option)
open_questions: Base management fee ~$1.2M/qtr below the 0.375%/qtr formula on avg gross assets — waiver or definition? 10-Q related-party note is the check (blue NEW-A, could cut either way)
Total-return lookback duration (4 vs 12 quarters) — determines how long the 1.03x normalized coverage persists
SWK consideration-share lockup terms — merger agreement transfer-restriction section unread (blue NEW-B)
tax_note: BDC distributions are predominantly ordinary income: the headline 19.9% yield is ~10% after-tax at the ~50% marginal rate; spillover ~$0.68/sh (two quarters pre-funded) is real but taxed the same. Entry is for total return at a discount, not for the yield.
